body.purpose: Body text, forms, tables, money columns

label.purpose: Field labels and compact meta lines

typographyMeta.note: Self-hosted variable woff2 (latin + latin-ext) bundled in src/assets/fonts — nothing is fetched at runtime.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Firm pill button with marigold accent, used sparingly
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; background: #b45309; color: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(146,64,14,0.3); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.16); cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.12s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #92400e; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White hairline button, used for cancel and secondary actions
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid #dfe6ef; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fff; border-color: #c3cddb; }

components.name: Nav Item
components.description: Pill-shaped navigation item, active filled marigold-soft, inactive text ink
components.css: .ds-nav-item { border-radius: 0.75rem; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-item.active { background: #fdf1d7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid rgba(180,83,9,0.3); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.08); } .ds-nav-item.inactive { color: #0f172a; border: 1px solid transparent; } .ds-nav-item.inactive:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); }

components.name: Modal
components.description: Frosted glass modal sheet over a dimmed, blurred page — blur only on the chrome, never on content
components.css: .ds-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.4); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); } .ds-modal-sheet { border-radius: 1.25rem; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.96), rgba(255,255,255,0.91)); backdrop-filter: blur(22px) saturate(1.5); box-shadow: 0 32px 70px -30px rgb(15 23 42 / 0.55); } .ds-modal-header { border-bottom: 1px solid #dfe6ef; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } .ds-modal-body { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; max-height: 94vh; overflow-y: auto; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like plain work sitting on a well-lit desk — glass panels float above a static daylight canvas, never AI-generated gloss or neon. The owner (an elderly PG manager) should never feel confused by decorative noise; every control must shout its size in plain English, and the marigold accent must remain rare enough to mean something.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary accent (marigold #b45309) is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders on content cards are rgba(15,23,42,.07) at 1px. No 2px borders, no faux-depth via thick lines.

rules.name: The Glass-Only-on-Chrome Rule
rules.body: `backdrop-filter: blur(18px)` + `saturate(1.6)` appears only on the fixed chrome: sticky header, sidebar, bottom nav, modal sheet. Content cards receive no blur.

rules.name: The One Size Rule
rules.body: Root font-size is 18px. All other sizes derive from this scale; no arbitrary pixel sizes.

rules.name: The Sentence-Case Rule
rules.body: Buttons, field labels, and navigation are written in sentence case with plain words; only short status badges are set in caps.

rules.name: The Fixed-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Header (sticky, glass-strong), sidebar (floating glass panel, 288px wide on lg), and bottom nav (floating frosted bar, inset from the edges on phones) are always present and never scroll away.

dos: Use marigold #b45309 on ≤10% of any screen surface area.
Keep content card borders at 1px rgba(15,23,42,.07).
Apply backdrop-filter: blur(18px) only on fixed chrome layers; use the strong variant for chrome over scrolling content.
Set root font-size to 18px; scale all other text from this root.
Write all labels in plain English; never abbreviate beyond common understanding.
Use hairline (1px) borders everywhere; never 2px unless context demands.
Preserve ≥18px text size never to shrink below accessibility floor.
donts: Use 2px or heavier borders on content cards — hairline only.
Apply backdrop-filter: blur to scrolling content or cards — only fixed chrome.
Add animated washes or moving backgrounds — three static radial washes plus a paper grain, painted once behind everything.
Use rounded corners smaller than .75rem on controls or larger than 1.25rem on modals.
Let the primary accent dominate — marigold must stay rare and meaningful.
Shrink body text below 18px root Equivalent; no text-xs on form labels or primary buttons.
Use system display faces without a serif fallback; keep the Georgia/Serif pairing.
Set long labels in caps; caps are for short status badges only.
Repeat the same instruction on every control in a grid; state it once and keep the tiles quiet.
